summary.text: Melanie Miller is a Republican state representative from Ohio House of Representatives District 67 who has served since January 2023 and is seeking re-election on the November 3, 2026 ballot. A former pregnancy care center executive director, she chairs the Arts, Athletics, and Tourism Committee.

paragraphs.text: Miller earned a B.A. in communication and digital media and film from Cleveland State University.

Her career experience includes working as executive director of the Ashland Pregnancy Care Center and as Youth Ministries director at The Salvation Army Kroc Corps Community Center, and she joined the Northern Medina County Chamber Alliance.
Miller won the District 67 seat in 2022 by winning the Republican primary over Ron Falconi and Terry Robertson and defeating Drew Burge in the general election; her predecessor was Kris Jordan.
In the 2025–2026 session she chairs the Arts, Athletics, and Tourism Committee and serves on the Children and Human Services, Health, and Technology and Innovation committees.
